Description: One-time bootstrap for the protected ProofToAct release control plane. Applying this template is an administrator action outside every release workflow; the retained controller table is not part of application teardown.

GitHubOidcProviderArn.Description: Existing GitHub Actions OIDC provider in the approved AWS account.

ArtifactBucketName.Description: Existing private versioned artifact bucket accepted by the read-only preflight.

Properties.Description: Source-owned maximum-permissions boundary for the exact ProofToAct Gate Two CloudFormation service role and rollback envelope.
CloudFormation-only execution role for one prooftoact-gate2 CREATE change set and automatic rollback.
Protected GitHub OIDC role that can upload exact artifacts and prepare one reviewed CREATE change set; it cannot execute it, invoke the application, or assume drill or evidence roles.

Credential-isolated GitHub OIDC coordinator for one-shot store transitions and read-only provider finalization across the five release lanes. It has no provider mutation, invocation, secret, KMS, role-assumption, or application-database credential capability.

Separate protected GitHub OIDC role that can execute one separately approved CREATE change set and enable termination protection; it cannot prepare artifacts, create change sets, deploy directly, invoke the application, or assume drill roles.

Separate protected GitHub OIDC role for one bounded live drill. The frozen application has one EvidenceOperatorPrincipalArn for its drill and inner evidence roles, so this role retains only those exact assumptions; an independent outer evidence role cannot dispatch or assume them.

Independent protected GitHub OIDC role for read-only release-control and the exact frozen deployment-attestation inventory. It cannot dispatch, deploy, invoke, mutate the controller table, or assume another role.

Independent protected GitHub OIDC provider dispatcher that can delete only the named gate2 stack through its exact service role after external physical-stack identity verification. It has no release-control table access.
Independent protected GitHub OIDC role for safety-reducing expiry terminalization of exact effect records. It cannot dispatch, reserve budget, deploy, invoke, assume roles, or delete state.
